notes.title: Rapture Session & Pro Update 5 - Now available!
notes.notes:
[b]Rapture Session[/b] and [b]Rapture Pro[/b] continues to evolve: version 2.0.5 offers several new features as well as some fixes.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8551658/d8a331a0dc0434fdfc9485e72a6d5ecdaeed0975.png[/img]

[h1]Poly Synth Instrument Page[/h1]

Including a graphic that indicates the instrument type has always been regarded as one of [b]Rapture Pro[/b] and [b]Rapture Session's[/b] more helpful features. One such graphic is now provided for poly synth programs too.

[h1]50 New Poly Synth Sounds[/h1]

And since there’s a Poly Synth instrument page, why not include some new sounds to go along with? Why not, indeed—there are now 50 new sounds with the core install. 

[h1]Load Waveform and Save Program Improvements[/h1]

[b]Rapture Pro[/b] now remembers independent locations for Load Program and Save Program, which solves the potential annoyance of having to switch back and forth between folders when loading and saving.

[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1][list]
[*] The multi-sample loading process is now multithreaded, which gives much faster loading of programs with samples that take up lots of memory. 
[*] The introduction of resource sharing means resources aren’t reloaded if they’re shared with the previous program. 
[*] The bug where the eighth instrument control retained the settings from a previously loaded program has been fixed.
[*] Improvement to the authorization process for both Mac and Windows computers that are on slower connections. [/list]
[h1]Steam Changes:[/h1][list]
[*] Improved Install Script for x86 only machines
[*] Demo has been updated to the latest version[/list]

notes.title: Maintenance Update 10.28.16
notes.notes:
[h1]Install Scripts Updated:[/h1][list]
We've updated our scripts to better handle users upgrading between our products and reinstalling on the same machine. This is laying some of the groundwork for the upcoming Rapture Session & Pro functionality updates. This applies to:
[*] Rapture Session
[*] Rapture Pro
[*] Rapture LE (Legacy)
[*] Rapture 1.2.2 (Legacy)
[*] Dimension LE (Legacy)
[*] Dimension Pro (Legacy)
[/list]

[h1]Authorization:[/h1][list]
[*][b] SteamReg Updated[/b]
Last week we identified an issue that could impact new users registering or existing users reinstalling Rapture Session & Pro, where the application would stay in Demo Mode.

While this issue has now been resolved, Demo Mode can still pop up occasionally depending on your configuration. We've created a guide on troubleshooting here: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=787510489

[h1]Sample File Updates:[/h1][list]
[*] We've identified a few missing samples and added them

Note: There's a few samples that we've identified which seem to have been lost in a build failure/hdd crash some time ago. These are still under investigation and we'll try to get them in with the next update.
[/list]

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to start a post in our technical assistance forum. http://steamcommunity.com/app/352290/discussions/1/

notes.title: Rapture Pro 2.0.2 Update Released!
notes.notes:
This is an update to the Rapture Pro core installer and contains several fixes, workflow enhancements and compatibility improvements.

[h1]Fixes and Workflow Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Significantly reduced loading times
[*]Decreased start up time when EG and SG folders are populated by third-party files
[*]Program logging is now off by default. It can be turned on in the Options menu
[*]Logs can now be found in Cakewalk Content\rapture pro\logs
[*]Sample file management improvements
[*]Save Program As… dialogue populates with the currently loaded program name
[/list]
[h1]Compatibility Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fully compatible with Windows hosts, especially Cubase 8, Studio One 3, Ableton Live 9, FL Studio, Bitwig Studio, and Reaper 4
[*]Resolved an issue with stuck notes in FL Studio
[*]MIDI CC envelopes are now rendered properly after freeze/bounce
[*]Tooltips are now displayed in Windows DAWs
[*]Bank art for migrated Dimension Pro and Rapture Classic is now installed
[*]Oscillator Multi-Mode Voices Control is now fluidly adjustable
[*]Resolved a case where the spacebar would not start playback in Logic Pro [*]when the Rapture Pro window was in focus (CWBRN-33462)
[*]Pitch Bend now responds to all assigned MIDI Channels
[*]Added the Dimension Pro multisample path as a fallback location for legacy programs if samples are not found
[*]Resolved an issue where .sfz files with forward slashes would prevent multisamples from loading
[*]Resolved issues with Galbanum Piscis expansion pack
[*]Programs in the Rapture Pro core installer have been completely mastered for consistent volumes
[/list]

notes.title: Rapture Pro 2.0.1 Update Released!
notes.notes:
The Rapture Pro 2.0.1 maintenance update contains several new features, fixes, and workflow enhancements. 

[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1][list]
[*]Next/Previous buttons can now be MIDI Learned from the Options menu
[*]Next/Previous buttons now move between Program Types
[*]Simplified save of Elements: an empty Elements folder is now available in the Rapture Pro content directory
[*]More visual feedback for Elements: Element buttons are now lit-up when active and dark when inactive. The current Element is marked.
[*]Single-click to load programs from the Browser
[*]Accepts custom bank art for expansion packs
[*]Increased visibility of selected bank in Browser
[*]“Clear search” button was added to the search area
[*]Migrated Rapture Classic & Dimension Pro folders now display their own bank art instead of the default.
[/list]
[h1][b]Fixes and Workflow Enhancements:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[b]Automation/MIDI[/b]
[*]XY Pad's Speed control value persists after closing and reopening the UI

[b]Browser[/b]
[*]Using Previous/Next Program buttons to load programs now increments the load count
[*]Previous/Next Program buttons now update the Info section of the Browser

[b]DSP[/b]
[*]STEPGEN MIDI Note Entry now accepts MIDI
[*]Clicking the Chain button on Element 5 on Mixer page no longer causes stuck notes

[b]Misc[/b]
[*]Programs with non-default locations correctly load with the Previous button
[*]Step Generator now works as expected in Cubase 8
[*]Instrument Page art is no longer visible on other pages
[*]Rapture Pro no longer crashes on program load when running inside Vienna [*]Ensemble Pro (CWBRN-32761)

[b]UI[/b]
[*]Output meter tooltips no longer display UNDEFINED
[*]XY Assignments now work as expected from the Instrument Page
[*]Browser redraws correctly in FL Studio
[*]Instrument Page art no longer bleeds through to other pages
[*]Fixed mouse cursor/crosshair behaviors
[*]The cursor no longer leaves “trails” in the XY Pad
[*]Rapture Pro About page is properly centered on all pages
[/list]

[b]NOTE[/b]: Re:Install:
1. Make sure STEAM fully updates
2. Run Rapture Pro once standalone, before attempting to load in your favorite DAW.
